<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.DownSlopeConnectivity: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Calculates the downslope component of the index of sediment connectivity of Cavalli et al.: for each cell, the sum along its flow path down to the network of the length of each step divided by the weight and the slope of its cell. Low values mark the cells well connected to the network.

**Toolbox folder:** Hillslope<br>
**Status:** Draft<br>
**Keywords:** connectivity, sediment, raster<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.DownSlopeConnectivity`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inFlow` | raster file |  |  | The map of the D8 flowdirections. |
| `inNet` | raster file |  |  | The map of the network, the target of the connectivity. |
| `inSlope` | raster file | m/m |  | The map of the slope, as from Slope. Values below 0.005 are raised to 0.005. |
| `inWeights` | raster file |  |  | The optional map of the weights, the impedance to the sediment flow, from 0 to 1, as 1 - roughness / maximum roughness in Cavalli et al. |
| `pWeight` | Double |  |  | The constant weight, used if the map of the weights is not given. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outConnectivity` | output file |  | The downslope component of the connectivity: the sum of the flow lengths divided by weight and slope, along the flow path down to the network. It is 0 on the network, and novalue where the path leaves the map or the data before reaching it. |

**References**

- Cavalli M., Trevisani S., Comiti F., Marchi L., 2013. Geomorphometric assessment of spatial sediment connectivity in small Alpine catchments. Geomorphology, 188, 31-41. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.geomorph.2012.05.007
